huawei-cloud-sg-manage v1.0.1

- Removed Step 0: skill-quality-cli installation instructions from SKILL.md.
- SKILL.md now assumes skill-quality-cli is ensured by the provided install script; installation details trimmed.
- Documentation for CLI installation and configuration moved to references/cli-installation-guide.md.
- Minor updates to prerequisites and dependency info to reduce duplication.
- Removed legacy documentation file skill-card.md.

Initial release of huawei-cloud-sg-manage for managing Huawei Cloud security groups.

- Supports listing, querying, diagnosing, and managing Huawei Cloud VPC security groups and rules.
- Includes 11 actions: list groups/rules, diagnose port connectivity, analyze conflicts, audit over-exposed rules, and full CRUD for groups/rules.
- Query/analyze operations auto-execute (read-only); create/update/delete actions require preview and explicit user confirmation.
- All actions run through the local hcloud (KooCLI) CLI; no Python SDK or raw API requests.
- Built-in safeguards and warnings for risky operations and critical firewall impacts.
